notes.title: Update 1.7.0
notes.notes:
[h1]Hello everyone![/h1]

Firstly I would like to say that there is an new DLC that not only allows you to support the artist of kitties, but also to get special unique rewards, such as: 💎[b]unique badge[/b], ✨[b]unique effect[/b] for the nickname and the whole 🗝️[b]15 keys[/b] for the cats carriers!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3146000/Idle_Kitties_Online__Supporter_Pack/?curator_clanid=45068800


[h2]What's new:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added full support for Steam Deck, even for chat!
[*] Added collection badges! To get a badge you need to collect all cats from one collection (not counting legendary ones) and then pick up your badge in the collections menu.
[*] Removed case opening delay
[*] Removed case recycling delay
[*] Improved visibility of equipped items in inventory
[*] Improved visibility in the cat crafting menu.
[/list]

meowmeowmeowmeowmeowmeow

notes.notes:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3062030/Idle_Kitties_Online/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3146000/


Hi everyone, long time no see!
Here's a look at a new update that changes the rotation of collections and more!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068800/0c479cb20734698c61bd69288d4870b2aca27415.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068800/3a078be8c5c871023944673ca81ae9adab4f2afe.png[/img]

[h2]Whats new:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Animals and Space collections are going to rare pool
[*] New collections Sweet and Jewelry are added to regular drop pool
[*] Added case recycle system. Now you can recycle every case for double fish amount
[*] Added collections menu. This is where you can conveniently track collected cats by collections and watch them
[*] Updated Steam Timeline feature with more icons and events
[*] Equipped items now marked in the inventory. To unequip an item, you must click on it again
[*] Added system of pins and nickname effects (will be available in the next update)
[*] Small fixes
[/list]

have fun

notes.title: Update 1.3.0
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068800/0d335c20050489d52f70b32b96003aeb08064628.png[/img]
Mew mew mew

[list]
[*] Crafting added! you can now improve the rarity of cats 10 to 1! For example: if you use 3 cats from the regular box and 7 from the carrier box, then the chance to get a new cat from the pool of the regular box will be 30%, and from the pool of the carrier 70% and so on. at the same time, the maximum quality of improvement is mythical.
[*] Added sorting buttons. now you can sort by new/old and by rarity!
[*] Added collection names to cats descriptions
[*] Added additional info to red trust factor icon
[*] Fixed non stackable gold fish
[/list]

I hope you will like this! Have a meow day
